character.ma.name: Ma
character.ma.bio: Rafi's mother. Worries constantly about household rent and Rafi's safety on Dhaka streets.
character.mintu.name: Mintu
character.mintu.bio: Childhood buddy running a lively tea stall in Mirpara. Knows every local whisper and road condition.
character.kamal.name: Kamal Bhai
character.kamal.bio: Reliable neighborhood bike mechanic. Offers a 20% repair discount to riders he trusts.
character.nabila.name: Nabila
character.nabila.bio: College student commuting daily on a tight budget. Bargains smartly but always pays fair.
character.tanvir.name: Tanvir
character.tanvir.bio: Fast-paced corporate professional traveling between Motinagar and Gulbari. Hates traffic jams.
character.rahim.name: Rahim Chacha
character.rahim.bio: Veteran resident who knows every narrow alley, hidden cut, and shortcut across Dhaka.
character.ferdousi.name: Mrs. Ferdousi
character.ferdousi.bio: Mother traveling with her young child. Demands exceptionally cautious and steady riding.
character.jamil.name: Jamil
character.jamil.bio: Mysterious late-night customer offering generous cash for rides into quiet back alleys.
character.morshed.name: SI Morshed
character.morshed.bio: Strict but fair traffic sub-inspector who keeps key intersections and checkpoints orderly.
character.bablu.name: Bablu
character.bablu.bio: Friendly bazaar trader frequently hauling goods and heavy supply bundles between markets.
